target.title: docs: respect configured Crabbox provider for agent tests
target.body:
Related: #104485

## What Problem This Solves

Ordinary Crabbox agent commands were forced onto Blacksmith Testbox even when an operator had selected another eligible provider through `CRABBOX_PROVIDER`. That made machine-local provider preferences ineffective and could also cause local-container execution to be described as remote/Testbox proof.

## Why This Change Was Made

Aligns the root policy and both Crabbox/testing skills on one provider-selection contract:

1. Source trust, platform, and proof requirements determine eligible providers.
2. An explicit eligible provider requested by the user wins.
3. Ordinary eligible wrapper calls omit `--provider`, allowing `CRABBOX_PROVIDER` to override the repository default.
4. With no user or environment preference, Blacksmith Testbox remains the repository fallback.

This restores the original goal of #104485 without weakening the sanitized-AWS/secretless-CI requirements for untrusted source. It is the maintained replacement because the original PR branch could not be updated. Original contributor: @hxy91819.

## User Impact

Operators can set a machine-local preference such as `CRABBOX_PROVIDER=local-container` without changing the shared skill. AWS or another eligible provider can be selected the same way. Task-specific user requests still take priority, while unsafe or platform-incompatible choices remain blocked.

## Evidence

- Current head: `87d3e60e975c4f4ae969b13c0c302b1cf6adda82`.
- Dependency contract checked in Crabbox source: config files load before environment overrides, `CRABBOX_PROVIDER` overrides the configured provider, and an explicit CLI `--provider` remains the final override.
- Claude via acpx independently routed the policy cases correctly: env `local-container` -> local Docker proof with no explicit provider; unset env -> Blacksmith fallback; untrusted credential-hydrated Testbox request -> sanitized AWS or secretless CI.
- Claude via acpx ran a real inherited-provider command with no explicit `--provider`: `node scripts/crabbox-wrapper.mjs run --id cbx_b5d22ebde587 --no-sync --timing-json -- corepack pnpm test test/scripts/crabbox-wrapper.test.ts`.
- Wrapper output: `provider=local-container`, lease `cbx_b5d22ebde587`, local Docker proof, 195/195 tests passed, exit 0. Cleanup verified: container removed and lease status returned not found.
- `oxfmt --check AGENTS.md .agents/skills/crabbox/SKILL.md .agents/skills/openclaw-testing/SKILL.md`
- `git diff --check`
- Fresh autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Exact-head GitHub checks are pending.
